title: Consultation confirmed
body: Thanks for booking with Enzo Interiors. Your consultation is confirmed — we will call the day before to check access and parking. If anything changes, just reply here.

title: Design ready to view
body: Your design is now available in the portal under Designs. Take your time with it, and use Approve or Request Changes when you are ready. Happy to talk it through on a call if easier.

title: Preparing for installation
body: Ahead of installation week, please clear the room and leave a clear route from the front door. Our fitters arrive at 8am and will protect floors and doorways on the way in.

title: Polite invoice reminder
body: A gentle reminder that your invoice is now due. Our bank details are on the invoice itself — once payment reaches us we will mark it as paid on your account.

title: Current lead times
body: Current lead time from design sign-off to installation is around 6 to 8 weeks, depending on worktop selection. Stone templating adds roughly a fortnight after the carcasses are in.
